public_definitions: The task requires comparing the 2013 application volume for United States and Canada using the public infrastructure grant application dashboard.
The dashboard is the only evidence source for determining which country had the larger 2013 volume.
The option to open the country grant intake follow-up record for the country with the larger 2013 volume must be selected.
uncertain: The chart does not explicitly state the unit of measurement for the application volume (e.g., applications, millions of applications).
The chart does not show the full data range for 2013 for both countries; only the 2013 data point is labeled for each.
